subject: Discovery recap + proposed trial charter & owner tracker
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed trial charter & owner tracker

Hi Samira — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and a proposed lightweight charter for the trial so your team can review and confirm owners. I put suggested owners in parentheses. Please flag anything missing.

Goal (what success looks like)
- Achieve parity for our summarization + reranking flow on a 2-week trial: qualitative parity in outcomes for 3 representative queries + token-cost estimate under $0.005/token (or callout if run-rate differs). (Success owners: Acme Product + Redwood Solutions)

Scope / evaluation plan
- Ingest sample dataset (100k short docs) and run 3 scenario tests: query accuracy, latency under 300ms median p50 for 1k qps baseline, and cost/runbook for 2-week window.
- Redwood provides: hosted trial endpoint, infra config recommendation, KV-prefix caching enabled, and an engineer for setup support (Ben).
- Acme provides: sample dataset, app test harness, and primary security contact for access approvals.

Timeline (proposed)
- Wed Feb 23: kickoff + AWS role/access handshake (30–45m)
- Thu Feb 24–Mon Mar 8: trial execution window (2 weeks)
- Tue Mar 9: wrap / decision review (30m)

Ownership snapshot (proposed RACI shorthand)
- Infra access & IAM: Responsible = Acme infra / Account SRE, Consulted = Redwood infra eng (Ben)
- App integration & harness: Responsible = Acme App Eng, Support = Redwood SE (Priyom)
- Security & audit review: Responsible = Acme Security (Samira), Informed = Redwood Security
- Procurement / SOW / billing: Responsible = Acme Procurement; Redwood Sales to support (Tessa)

Open asks for you to confirm:
1) Security contact for SOC2 evidence / audit logs (Samira — can you confirm person and whether a short SOC2 slice is acceptable?)
2) Procurement lead + preferred billing cadence (procure@acme-ai.com?)
3) Confirm dataset delivery format and whether we should use S3 role or temporary transfer.

Attachments: acme_poc_evaluation_matrix.xlsx (proposed metrics & test cases), redwood-trial-ops-checklist.pdf (ops checklist), mutual-action-plan.docx (living MAP).

If this looks OK I’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan and propose the kickoff on Wed Feb 23 at 10am PT.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
email: tessa@redwood.com | mobile: +1 (415) 555-0172

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from my side:

- Security: I own the trial security gate but will delegate day-to-day to Diego (diego.security@acme-ai.com). SOC2 slice is fine for the trial; we will need to see network flow logs and an example of audit logs for key requests.
- Procurement: Yes please loop in procure@acme-ai.com for the billing cadence discussion — they prefer net-30 on pilot contracts.
- Dataset: We can stage on S3 and grant a read-only role for Redwood; I’ll coordinate the IAM owner and share role ARN before kickoff.

On timeline — Wed Feb 23 at 10am PT works for the kickoff. One ask: can Redwood circulate a short list of acceptance criteria that we can route internally (security & product) before kickoff?

Forwarding your original message below for context.

Thanks — adding an operational RACI and a couple clarifications so we don’t trip on Day 1. I uploaded a working RACI + access checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cPOCSharedDrive (see file "POC_RACI_and_Access.md").

Quick points:
- Access model options: preferred = cross-account read-only IAM role to S3 (fastest); fallback = temporary presigned transfers via SFTP. We need the ARN before the kickoff to pre-seed access.
- KV/caching: we will enable prefix caching for the reranker flow by default for the trial; this reduces cost and keeps latency tight.
- Logging: we can provide sample audit logs (request id, token usage, latency) — I’ll attach a 1-page sample in the drive and attach the ops checklist here (redwood-trial-ops-checklist.pdf).

Attached: redwood-trial-ops-checklist.pdf (ops tasks + who does what).

Suggested RACI snapshot (top-level)
- Responsible: Redwood SE (Ben) for trial deployment & Acme App Eng for harness
- Accountable: Acme Product (Samira) for acceptance + Redwood Sales (Tessa) for MAP
- Consulted: Redwood Security (Priyom) for audit/logging questions
- Informed: Procurement (procure@acme-ai.com) and Legal where redlines happen

I’ll also draft a one-page acceptance criteria list (technical + business) and post to the drive before EOD tomorrow.

—
